Jan Scientist's mission continues. 

A roughly 20-hour expansion to the award-winning personal survival game The Alters - available now.

The Oasis - a lush paradise emerging from desolation - becomes Jan's obsession. One he cannot grasp alone. Assemble a crew of specialist alters: Geologist, Biologist, Chemist, Physicist. Together, you'll terraform a hostile planet, build an underground research base, and uncover mysteries that may reshape everything.
But can we really understand everything?

The Alters: Last Variable is out now.
